audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup is framed around Steadfast Presence, and dosFull[0].d / report[5].t sell it as 'stops every dash near her — mobility dies inside the zone'. Ryze has no dash anywhere in his kit, so that clause is close to irrelevant against him. Meanwhile three interactions that DO apply never reach the page: Keeper's Verdict is a channel Rune Prison cancels, Poppy is untargetable during it, and Iron Ambassador's buckler gives her a shield that eats your burst.
audit.why: Kit: Ryze's abilities are a line projectile (Q), a 615-range slow/root (W), a 615-range projectile debuff (E) and a delayed portal (R) — no dash flag anywhere. Poppy's W is 20/18/16/14/12s and only punishes dashes. Her real lane threat is Heroic Charge (E, 14/13/12/11/10s, 475 range) pinning you to terrain for a stun. Keeper's Verdict (140/120/100s) carries channel and untargetable flags. Iron Ambassador (P) carries the shield flag.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence barely touches a dashless Ryze; Heroic Charge into a wall is the ability that kills you. Rune Prison cancels the Keeper's Verdict channel. Force out the buckler shield before committing.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is 100-140s and she is untargetable in it — Realm Warp adds no duel power.

edits.before: Stops every dash near her — mobility dies inside the zone. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: You have no dash, so it barely touches you — her Heroic Charge into a wall is the real threat.

edits.before: Poppy burns Steadfast Presence on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — your Rune Prison (615) cancels it outright.

edits.before: That’s Poppy’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Iron Ambassador's buckler shield eats your burst — force her to spend it.

notes: The whole matchup is keyed to Steadfast Presence via focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t, but W only punishes dashes and Ryze has none — the ability that actually decides the lane is Heroic Charge pinning him to terrain. I corrected the two shortest carriers of the wrong framing; re-keying focus.text and the loading screen is a larger change I did not make unilaterally (see questionsForUser). The mirror also reports dosFull[2].t reads 'W his dash mid-flight', which is wrong for a dashless Ryze but is 21 characters — under the applier's 25-char skip threshold, so it needs a manual fix on both sides.
